# Documentation for lib1 contrib library

This is a documentation example library, with some tricks related to selective preamble loading and dependencies.

The documentation file containing this introductory segment was generated during the library generation. The library was generated with the command (where ... represents the full path to those files):

```
php cli/contriblibrarybuilder.php lib1 /.../lib1intro.md /.../lib1a.mac /.../lib1b.mac
``` 
---

## lib1a_fun1(mode)<a id='lib1a_fun1'></a>

A function generating a "string". Demonstrating reuirement through documentation block.


| Argument name | type | description |
| ------------- | ---- | ----------- |
| mode | boolean | whether we recurse or not |




| Return type | description |
| ----------- | ------------|
| string | a string that concatenates plenty of things |
---


## lib1a_value1<a id='lib1a_value1'></a>

A value defined in lib1a, when required triggers the preamble of lib1a changing its presentation.
The same value defined in lib1b when loaded without any lib1a items will have differnt texput behaviour.
Note that we do not need to annotate the requirement for the value define elsewhere in lib1, it will be
automatically detected by the tooling.
---


## lib1b_value1<a id='lib1b_value1'></a>

A value defined in lib1b, as long as nothing in lib1a is present will not have a texput override.
